title: Relative flat scalar extension to a fibre-product stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $p:T\to S$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], and let $z\in X\times_S T$ [def-pc-base-change], $x=\mathrm{pr}_X(z)$ and $t=\mathrm{pr}_T(z)$. Let $M$ be any module over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, flat over $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$ with scalar restriction through $f^\sharp_x$. Then $\mathcal O_{X\times_S T,z}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}M$, restricted through $\mathrm{pr}_T^\sharp_z$, is flat over $\mathcal O_{T,t}$. No sheaf, quasi-coherence, finiteness or flatness of a scheme morphism is assumed.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 10.100.1(1), proof; Examples Tag 0FLS, canonical stalk map

proof.text: Write R,A,B,C for the stalk rings. Use pullback.condition to identify f(x) with p(t) and transport the R-action on B. TensorProduct.lift of the projection stalk maps gives D=A tensor_R B -> C. The stalk-map composition and congruence formulas ensure agreement over R and the restrictions to A and B. Apply the existing fibre-product stalk lemma to obtain D-flatness of C.

Give M tensor_R N its A tensor_R B action using TensorProduct.Algebra.module and the B-action transported through TensorProduct.comm. Construct both balanced additive maps using TensorProduct.liftAddHom. The projection compatibility equations verify A- and B-balancing, and scalar towers verify R-balancing. Tensor induction proves the maps inverse and natural in each B-linear map N -> Nprime. Apply Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap first over R to M, then over A tensor_R B to C; transport injectivity through the balanced equivalence and use Module.Flat.iff_lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap. All these algebraic steps are proved by private helpers in the item; no new sorry or module is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem pullback_stalk_relative_flat_extension
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (p : T ⟶ S) (z : ↥(pullback f p))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.fst f p) z)))
    (hM : Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f ((pullback.fst f p) z)))
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap ((pullback.fst f p) z)).hom).obj M)) :
    Module.Flat (T.presheaf.stalk ((pullback.snd f p) z))
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((pullback.snd f p).stalkMap z).hom).obj
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars ((pullback.fst f p).stalkMap z).hom).obj M))
